# Northvalley Intelligence

Northvalley Intelligence helps local service businesses in Cobb, Paulding, and Douglas counties get found, convert leads, and clean up the workflows behind the work.

Primary site: https://northvalleyintel.com
Contact: hello@northvalleyintel.com
Service area focus: Marietta, Cobb County, Paulding County, Douglas County, and nearby Atlanta metro service areas.

## What Northvalley Does

Northvalley is a custom software company using AI agents to make practical, workflow-shaped software more accessible. The public website speaks in customer language because owners usually start with lead, follow-up, scheduling, and workflow problems rather than software requirements.

Northvalley helps practical service businesses improve the full path from local discovery to lead conversion to operational follow-through. Those conversations become the entry point for better workflow, automation, AI-agent systems, and custom software when that is the right next step.

The work includes:

- Website Growth Assessment
- Custom software assessment
- AI-agent workflow systems
- Local lead path assessment
- Operational AI assessment
- Knowledge chaos assessment
- AI-answer readiness and local search clarity
- Workflow modernization for lead intake, scheduling, follow-up, customer information, and repeated work
- Agent-native service delivery: making a business usable directly from inside an AI assistant

## Website Growth Assessment

The Website Growth Assessment is not a generic SEO score, security scan, or technical website doctor. It is an entry point for understanding whether lead generation, conversion, and follow-up problems point to better workflow, automation, or custom software.

It reviews whether a local business website helps nearby customers and AI answer engines understand:

- what the business does
- where the business serves
- why the business can be trusted
- what action a visitor should take next
- where contact, estimate, consultation, or booking friction exists

A one-page teaser report is emailed after request. The full paid assessment includes page-level evidence, scoring logic, exact missing signals, and prioritized fixes.

## Agent-Native Service Delivery

Northvalley builds agent-native service surfaces so a customer can use a business
directly from inside the AI assistant they are already using, instead of being
handed a list of names and a phone number.

The design rule is that the assistant submits a REQUEST and never confirms a
commitment. The business owner reviews and confirms the work. This is enforced in
code, not only in wording.

An agent lane is added onto the intake a business already has, so there is one
record, one notification, and one set of rules rather than a parallel booking
system the owner has to check separately.

Northvalley runs its own agent-native surface:

- Endpoint: https://northvalleyintel.com/mcp (Model Context Protocol, public, no auth)
- Tools: list_services, request_assessment, request_consult
- request_assessment submits a request for a Website Growth Assessment. It never
  returns assessment findings, scores, or report content. The one-page teaser is
  emailed; the complete assessment is a paid engagement.
- request_consult submits a request to talk about custom software or an
  agent-native surface. It does not book or confirm a meeting.
- Both write tools return a pending status for Northvalley to review.
- Northvalley works with clients anywhere in the United States. There is no
  service-area gate; the Cobb, Paulding, and Douglas county focus is an input to
  the lead-growth analysis inside an assessment, not a limit on who it works with.

Client reference implementation, live today:

- Business: Medina Clean, a bilingual residential and small-business cleaning
  service near Woodstock, Georgia.
- Endpoint: https://medinaclean.com/mcp (Model Context Protocol, public, no auth)
- Tools: check_service_area, list_services, get_pricing_rules, get_estimate,
  request_appointment
- Behavior: service-area check gates estimates and booking; appointment requests
  return a pending status for owner review; responses are available in English
  and Spanish.
- Added onto the existing appointment intake, so requests reach the owner through
  the same path the website form already used.

Northvalley builds and operates these surfaces for client businesses as a service.
